Joystick startup and movement ownership is shared with the portable Unix input runtime and covered by state-transition contracts.
The header contributes no runtime symbol candidate; its platform state and declarations are represented by the typed Unix runtime facade.
All 341 inventoried QGL initialization, shutdown, logging and OpenGL dispatch names have exact ownership in the portable Unix facade; native loader calls remain host-adapter responsibilities.
Unix signal installation and fatal-signal handling are owned with deterministic error contracts.
The Unix DMA lifecycle, submission, position and sound-memory helpers are owned by the portable audio host facade.
The header contributes no runtime symbol candidate; its assembly-facing contract is superseded by typed MiniLang helpers.
The header contributes no runtime symbol candidate; its GL window state is represented by the typed Unix runtime state.
Console history, system lifecycle, event queuing, dynamic-library and bounded main-loop entry points are owned by the portable Unix runtime.
Address conversion, LAN classification, socket lifecycle and packet queue behavior are owned with deterministic portable networking contracts.
Paths, time, user, file-list, processor, vector-snap and numeric helper semantics are owned by the portable Unix runtime.
Unix x86 VM compilation and compiled-call entry points delegate to the verified memory-safe QVM decoded-plan backend.
